articles.title: Liverpool hand Pochettino nightmare Manchester United start after Yoro sees red
articles.summary: Green shoots of recovery have lasted longer in a blast furnace than in the Mauricio Pochettino era at Manchester United. On another abysmal Anfield day for the fallen giants of Manchester, Pochettino endured a baptism of fire from the eighth minute onwards when Leny Yoro was sent off for denying Alexander Isak a clear goalscoring opportunity. Liverpool would not be denied anything else while tormenting their old rivals yet again. Andoni Iraola indulged in his first fist-pumps towards the Kop after an utterly dominant, comfortable win illuminated by Rio Ngumoha and Florian Wirtz brilliance plus goals from Dominik Szoboszlai and Víctor Muñoz. Liverpool’s two creative forces were also on the scoresheet as Ngumoha became the youngster scorer in the fixture’s Premier League history. Continue reading...

articles.summary: Liverpool thrashed 10-man Manchester United 4-0 at Anfield on Sunday to climb to fourth in the Premier League.
